multica_import.confirm_message:
OpenCorvus will:
• Read the Multica Squad catalog in this project context.
• Let you choose uninstalled Squads, then synchronize their canonical packages to your global Agent Squad catalog for use across projects.
• Keep installed packages unchanged and leave imported Squads inactive.

Current project: {{directory}}
multica_import.mission_request: After completing the mandatory `mission_state` reads and first-wake Mission contract, call `panel` with `action: "multica_catalog"` to read every Multica Squad and its authoritative `installed` status in this project. If the catalog is empty, report that result and create no Task. Otherwise ask exactly one visible `question` with `multiple: true` and `custom: false`; include every catalog row, set each option `label` to the exact Squad name and its `value` to the exact Squad UUID, and put the Squad description, `installed` status, member count, and complete member roster in the option `description`. Never use a Squad UUID as the option label. Set `disabled: true` for every installed option and `disabled: false` for every uninstalled option, so all Squads stay visible while only uninstalled Squads are selectable. For every selected UUID whose catalog row has `installed: false`, create one independent Task in the same wake with `panel.create_task`, `promptProfile: "squad-sdk"`, and `queue: false`. Each complete Task request must include an `Original user input` section, the exact selected UUID and its complete catalog evidence, and require the Task to select the `heterogeneous-import` workflow, validate and import only that specified Squad, and leave the result inactive. Append every created Task ID to `tasks.md` immediately, then monitor all selected-Squad Tasks with one batch `panel.query_task` and report their separate real outcomes. Do not import directly in the Mission session, do not create a Task for an installed or unselected Squad, and never replace an installed package.

work_ledger.kind_description.work: A longer, multi-step conversation for research, analysis, and review-ready interactive deliverables.
work_ledger.tooltip.new_chat: Start a direct conversation for interactive work. Chat works with you in one project and does not coordinate child Tasks.
work_ledger.tooltip.automations: Open saved schedules that start work automatically at their configured times.
work_ledger.tooltip.expert_squads: Browse specialist capability packages that combine Agents, Skills, and Tools for a type of work.
work_ledger.tooltip.multica_import: Choose Multica squads to import into the current project through a coordinated Mission.
work_ledger.tooltip.channel: Connect an external messaging service so OpenCorvus can receive and reply to conversations there.
work_ledger.tooltip.organization.by_proj: Group each Chat, Mission, and standalone Task under the project directory that owns it.
work_ledger.tooltip.organization.one_lis: Combine unpinned work from all named projects into one list; Mission-owned Tasks remain nested under their Mission.
work_ledger.tooltip.sort.priority: Show critical and high-priority Tasks first; other work keeps normal priority.
work_ledger.tooltip.sort.updated: Show the work with the most recent activity first.
work_ledger.tooltip.sort.manual: Keep queued standalone Tasks in your drag order and otherwise use creation order.
work_ledger.tooltip.create.from_scratch: Start a Chat in a new anonymous project. You can choose a permanent project folder later.
work_ledger.tooltip.create.existing_fold: Choose a folder and use that directory as the project workspace.
